title: Ai marketing, anyone with experience?
author: Tom_Baron
selftext:
I absolutely hate marketing(im useless)  but at the same time totally realise its pointless making a game without it 

I built a silly multiplayer game, totally free with no sign up (this is not a plug so i wont link it) its actually really fun and has a small player base of colleagues that play it of their own volition so i know there is a little niche. I am going to test ai marketing with this as a dry run with no expectation. Has anyone got any success stories or tips to lead gpt work for example in the right direction when it comes to marketing?

The reason for this is ive put 100s of hours into another game and i want to hit the ground running for this one!

comments.author: Senior_Committee891
comments.body: Marketing doesn't work like that. There's no magic prompt that will suddenly make everything work. AI is really good at this stuff, but you still need to know what kind of content to create, how to create it, who your target audience is, and so on. Once you understand those things, you can get pretty decent results with AI if you know how to use it properly.

replies.author: Tom_Baron
replies.body: Im not looking for a magic prompt per se, im looking for a framework. I have a rough idea of my target market although the game in question for testing is far less niche and probably harder to market in that respect than the one i plan to make commercial. I would like to see how people have already done this successfully with ai so i can apply their learnings to my own strategy if applicable.

replies.author: Senior_Committee891
replies.body: I'd recommend recording some funny moments from your game and collecting a bunch of clips. Find similar games from your competitors and feed their trailers into an AI to break down how they're edited. Then give your clips to Opus and ask it to create a video using the editing style and ideas you got from analyzing your competitors' trailers. That could be a good starting point.

replies.author: Tom_Baron
replies.body: Thanks, thats actually incredibly helpful and productive advice. Ive done a rudimentary version of this for setting the itch page up but the advice around analysing competitors footage is brilliant.
